info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Jobs-v3-spec
info.description: The Job Listings Retrieval API provides access to a comprehensive list of available job applications within the careers section of the platform. This endpoint allows users to search and retrieve job postings, making it essential for job seekers looking to explore employment opportunities. Typical consumers include job applicants, recruiters, and third-party job listing platforms. By leveraging this API, developers can integrate job application data into their applications, enhancing the user experience for those seeking new careers.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of job applications.
get.description: Fetches all job applications submitted by users. This endpoint allows you to view application details, statuses, and related metadata.

requestBody.description: A request body containing the criteria for retrieving job applications. The body should adhere to the specified JSON schema, which outlines the required parameters and structure for the request.

204.description: The request has been successfully processed, but there is no content to return.

ListCareersApplicationsJobsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for a GET operation related to job applications. It expects a single string value.

ListCareersApplicationsJobsResponse_204.title: Job Operation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the job operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for tracking the job operation.

resultId.description: The ID of the result generated by the job operation.

state.description: The current state of the job operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the job operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the job operation.

audit.description: Details about the audit information of the job operation.

ListCareersApplicationsJobsResponse_204.description: Response schema for a job operation, providing status and audit information.

JobAudit.title: Job Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the job.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the job was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the job operation was initiated automatically.

JobAudit.description: Audit information related to a job operation.

x-processing-time.description: This header indicates the amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A value of 0 indicates that the processing time was negligible.
